sections.content: Your MRI report dated December 24, 2020 describes **severe osteoarthritis in both temporomandibular joints** and **anterior displacement of both articular discs without reduction**. The arthritis was progressive on the left and not significantly changed on the right compared with the December 27, 2017 MRI.
sections.title: Overview

data.evidence: The report states there is severe osteoarthritis of both TMJs. On the left, the joint shows progressive remodeling of the articular surfaces and large osteophytes; on the right, there is marked remodeling of the mandibular condyle and lateral osteophytes.
data.title: Severe bilateral TMJ osteoarthritis

data.evidence: Both discs are displaced anteriorly and medially and fail to return to their normal position when the mouth opens, described in the impression as anterior dislocation without reduction.
data.title: Bilateral nonreducing disc displacement

data.evidence: The left disc is described as macerated, and the left-sided osteoarthritis has progressed compared with the prior MRI. The right side was not significantly changed.
data.title: Left worse than right progression

rows.note: Not significantly changed from prior study
rows.value: Severe osteoarthritis with condylar remodeling and lateral osteophytes

rows.note: Progressive remodeling, large osteophytes, and macerated disc
Anteriorly and medially displaced; does not reduce on opening

data.evidence: The report identifies severe bilateral TMJ osteoarthritis, progressive on the left and not significantly changed on the right.
data.title: Main diagnosis

data.evidence: Both TMJ discs remain displaced when the mouth opens, which is reported as anterior dislocation without reduction.
data.title: Disc abnormality
